speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing frequent nosebleeds and bleeding from your mucous membranes, along with petechiae. Can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present, and have you noticed any unusual bruising or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any recent history of viral illness or medication use, such as aspirin, prior to the onset of these bleeding symptoms? Does the child have any known family history of bleeding disorders?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

text: The normal platelet count combined with the specific deficiency in GIIb/IIIa receptors confirms a diagnosis of Glanzmann thrombasthenia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Glanzmann thrombasthenia
